headline: Crypto Structure Brief: Ethereum Tops TVL; Stablecoin Circulation Falls
summary: Ethereum holds the largest chain TVL at $37.3 billion. Base and Solana follow with $4.7 billion each. USDT and USDC dominate stablecoin supply with $173.5 billion and $69.1 billion respectively. Multiple stablecoins show depegs and recent incidents affected several protocols.

sections.title: Chains & TVL
bullets: Base ranks second at $4.7 billion, followed by Solana at $4.7 billion and Tron at $4.4 billion.
BSC and Hyperliquid L1 complete the top six.

sections.title: DEX & fees
bullets: Aero Slipstream recorded the highest 24-hour DEX volume at $787 million.
Uniswap V4 and V3 each exceeded $630 million in daily volume.
Tether generated the largest fees at $17.0 million, followed by Circle USDC at $6.8 million.

sections.title: Stablecoins
bullets: USDT circulating supply stands at $173.5 billion and USDC at $69.1 billion.
USDe supply rose 8.6 percent over 30 days to $4.9 billion.
apxUSD and AP USDA trade below peg; Dola and Frax remain under watch.

sections.title: L2s
bullets: Base reports $14.0 billion TVS with 1.7 percent weekly growth.
Arbitrum One holds $8.7 billion TVS; Hyperliquid L3 reaches $5.7 billion.
OP Mainnet and Mantle exceed $1.3 billion and $975 million respectively.

sections.title: Security
bullets: Fourteen incidents reported in the last 14 days, including key compromises on Solana and BSC.
Largest losses exceeded $13 million on Hyperliquid L1 and $11.9 million on Ethereum-Bitcoin bridge.
Gas fees remain low across Ethereum, Base and Arbitrum.
